schematic_container_helper.config.commen: Enable or disable the core features of Container Helper.
When enabled, the mod will automatically find missing containers in the background and fill them.

OFF: Only fills the container currently pointed at.
ON: Automatically scans all containers within the specified radius.
Scanning radius for Area Fill Mode (1 - 32 blocks).
Rendering radius for missing item highlights (1 - 64 blocks).
If enabled, highlights and filling actions only apply to the current Litematica render layer.
Automatically hide highlights when a container's items match schematic requirements.
Receive data packets from servers (e.g., Servux) to sync inventory data without opening containers.
Render wireframes around schematic containers that are missing items.
If enabled, highlights are visible through terrain and blocks (X-Ray Mode).
Color for container highlights. Use Hex ARGB format (e.g., 0x808B4513).
Ticks between filling actions. Higher values fill containers more slowly.
Allows the mod to automatically extract items from shulker boxes in your inventory when needed.
schematic_container_helper.hotkey.commen: Press to immediately perform a filling action.
Quickly turn 'Continuous Auto-Fill' on or off.
Switch between 'Single Target' and 'Area Scan' modes.
Hotkey to open this mod's configuration menu (Default: L + C).
